description: Use when you need a trustworthy USD price for crypto assets (ETH, BTC, cbBTC, SOL, LINK, AAVE, stablecoins), fiat FX rates (EUR, GBP, JPY…) or metals (XAU, XAG): reads the Chainlink price feed contracts directly from Base or Ethereum in one multicall and returns price, last update time, age in seconds, a stale flag and the feed address so the value is verifiable on-chain. Up to 10 symbols per call. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

chain.description: Chain to read the feeds from.

symbols.description: Comma-separated asset symbols (max 10), e.g. "ETH,BTC,USDC,EUR". GET / lists all supported symbols per chain.

name: price
title: ScrapeMole Onchain: prices, DEX prices, ENS/Basenames, gas, tokens, balances, holders and transactions on Base and Ethereum: Chainlink USD prices
